newsitem.title: USA: Ronden Vending merges with Video Home.
newsitem.headline: Ronden Vending merges with Video Home.

text.p: Ronden Vending Corp said on Wednesday it merged with Video Home Shopping Inc, a Tennessee corporation located in Nashville.
The merger was completed on Dec. 30, 1996. Ronden has changed its name to VHS Network Inc in connection with the merger.

Pursuant to the terms of the merger agreement between Ronden and Video Home, Ronden issued 10,462,750 shares of its common stock to Video Home shareholders. Ronden also agreed to reserve, for future issuance to certain Video Home employees, 137,250 shares of its common stock.

After giving effect to the shares being issued in the merger and the shares contemplated to be issued under the employee stock purchase plan, Ronden has, on a fully diluted basis, 12,041,000 shares of its common stock issued and outstanding.
Video Home is a network marketing and distribution company which offers products and services to consumers through the medium of video tape.
Ronden is a publicly traded Florida corporation originally organized to own and operate vending machines.
